title: Indian Stock Market Plunges Amid Global Economic Uncertainty
summary: The Indian stock market experienced a significant downturn on July 8, with the Sensex falling by 1,700 points and the Nifty closing below 23,900. The cause of this decline is attributed to global economic uncertainty, including rising interest rates in the US. Investors have suffered losses of over ₹8 lakh crore due to the market crash.
summary_points: The Indian stock market experienced a significant downturn on July 8.
The Sensex fell by 1,700 points and the Nifty closed below 23,900.
Global economic uncertainty is believed to be the cause of this decline.
Investors have suffered losses of over ₹8 lakh crore due to the market crash.
Rising interest rates in the US are among the factors contributing to the downturn.
